caption: The drawing depicts a single large, cylindrical clay pot with a wide, slightly flared rim and rounded sides that taper inward toward the base. The pot is primarily shades of reddish brown with patches and streaks of lighter and darker browns, some grayish tones, and a few white marks dispersed across its surface. The interior of the pot is also visible and is rendered in darker, almost blackish hues. There are irregularities in the pot's texture and coloration, suggesting wear, aging, or hand-crafted origin. The pot sits on a plain, off-white or beige background with no additional objects present. At the bottom center of the image, the name "Lloyd C Lemcke" is written in small, plain text.
title: Brown Crock
